purpose: Engineering acceptance for reference-conditioned simulated G1 tracking; these thresholds are project criteria, not paper benchmark claims.
initialization: Reference frame zero only; no controlled robot state writes or resets afterwards
interpretation: Original hard-gate pass alone does not establish learned tracking quality
Every failed or unsuitable raw clip remains in the denominator
Body-pose tracking of 89_01 does not establish object balancing
CMU 88_08 is a hands-supported backward flip; no generic airborne backflip claim
Contact geometry is diagnostic, not measured contact force or guaranteed contact fidelity
90/180/360 target-video types require individual matching and physical verification
A moving upright ending is not static standing
